scenes.title: Testing Boundaries at the Jazz Club
scenes.summary: At a Tokyo jazz club, Ikezawa, Furuya, and detective Takei toast Muranishi's massive overseas sentence while trading veiled threats about police crackdowns and status.

scenes.title: Unfair Charges and Odd Jobs
scenes.summary: As Tokyo newsrooms prepare for a new era, Kawada begs a magazine Editor to cover Muranishi's unjust prosecution while the young crew scrambles to earn money elsewhere.

scenes.title: One Hundred Million Yen for Bail
scenes.summary: Toshi berates the crew for bringing in nothing while Kawada explains that a plea bargain will free Muranishi for one hundred million yen, though Toshi refuses to beg Ikezawa.

scenes.title: Two Ways To Raise the Money
scenes.summary: Kawada proposes releasing Kuroki's debut tape through a fast-growing retail chain while Toshi pushes to sell uncensored tapes underground with Furuya, and each sets out his own way.

scenes.title: Staying True to Herself
scenes.summary: Ikezawa offers Kuroki twenty million yen to sign exclusively with Poseidon, enough to help her mother and Muranishi, but Kuroki refuses when he orders her to shave.

scenes.title: An Office Day Job and a Missing Tape
scenes.summary: After a failed interview, a young crew member chats with a former Sapphire actress thriving in office work, then returns to discover that their master tape has vanished.

scenes.title: Industry Pressure and a Desperate Bet
scenes.summary: A video chain Proprietor shows Kawada a boycott warning from Poseidon's regulators and asks for proof of a hit, while Toshi hands the stolen master tape to Furuya for help.
scenes.location: video chain headquarters and Furuya's office

scenes.title: Promoting Her Own Debut
scenes.summary: Kuroki visits Kawada, turns down Poseidon, and insists on releasing and personally promoting her film in public to help save Muranishi and change how actresses are viewed.

scenes.title: Goodbye, Mother
scenes.summary: Kuroki tells her mother Kayo that she loves Muranishi, learns that Kayo kept her strict only to hold on to her estranged father, and quietly leaves home for good.

scenes.title: Fear in the Back Alleys
scenes.summary: Furuya leads Toshi into a grim Tokyo hideout, punishes his lieutenant Fujiwara for skimming gang funds, and orders Toshi to dispose of the body to prove his loyalty.

scenes.title: Our Goddess Convinces the Chain
scenes.summary: Kuroki and Kawada screen her bold debut tape for the video chain Proprietor, whose amazement overcomes Poseidon's threats and wins an order of two hundred tapes per city.

scenes.title: Times Have Changed
scenes.summary: Crowds line up for Kuroki's autographs on release day, and the chain Proprietor laughs off an industry Officer's threat letter by declaring that times have changed.

scenes.title: Fifty Million Yen in Cash
scenes.summary: When Kawada's advance payment falls short of the bail target, Toshi drops a bag holding fifty million yen onto the desk and tells Kawada not to ask how he got it.

scenes.title: Welcome Home, Director
scenes.summary: Freed under an eight-hundred-thousand-dollar plea deal paid by his colleagues, Muranishi returns to Japan to find his crew waiting and Kuroki surrounded by reporters.
scenes.location: prison office and Tokyo airport arrival lobby
